title: Approval of a one (1)-year Lease with United Parcel Service Inc., with associated rental rates: Covering the premises located at 2825 East Avenue P, Building 702, at the Palmdale landholdings of Los A
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a one (1)-year Lease with United Parcel Service Inc., with associated rental rates: Covering the premises located at 2825 East Avenue P, Building 702, at the Palmdale landholdings of Los Angeles World Airports, for estimated revenue of $772,480 over the term (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: One-year lease of Building 702 at 2825 East Avenue P in Palmdale to United Parcel Service Inc., with estimated revenue of $772,480 over the term.
